_source: Static UI keys for the mobile PR reject action sheet (route reject, pototype/mobile.jsx MobileRejectSheet L460-541). KEYS ONLY — every value is the Thai phrase that IS the phrases-layer key (read with tp). `title` (ปฏิเสธเอกสาร) and `cancel` (ยกเลิก) ALREADY exist in docs/extract/i18n-full.json phrases; the rest are NEW and collected in mobile-approve-reject-i18n.apply.json (B-255) — they resolve in Thai today, light up en/zh/ar once applied. `banner` carries a leading {no} slot substituted with the REAL PR no via a split-on-token Text.rich (Wei's en/zh/ar MUST keep {no}). The 5 reasonN presets are STATIC UI copy (like the notif filter pills) ported verbatim; tapping one FILLS the required reason field. The prototype's mock textarea prefill is DROPPED (§0 rule 3).
